evals.prompt: Sync the latest Eufemia icons from Figma and prepare the requested pull request.
evals.expected_output: The repository icon documentation is followed, and the pull request uses the documented title, short description, release date, and changelog format.
assertions: The pull request title uses the feat(Icons): add [icon names] format
The changelog lists genuinely new icon names under the intended release date

evals.prompt: Refresh existing Eufemia Figma icons and update the repository pull request metadata.
evals.expected_output: The workflow documentation is used, refreshed icons are not presented as newly added names, and the pull request description remains one short sentence.
assertions: The response distinguishes newly added icon names from refreshed existing icons
The pull request description is limited to one short sentence
The response uses the repository's documented icon workflow
